req.title: PUT rejects unknown player
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 when PUT targets a playerId that does not exist.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-012 requires that PUT /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} returns HTTP 404 when the squad number does not exist. The endpoint uses squad_number as the path parameter (not a UUID playerId). Three test cases are designed: (1) a positive case confirming an existing player can be updated (HTTP 204), proving the 404 path is not triggered spuriously; (2) a negative/primary case confirming a non-existent squad number yields exactly HTTP 404; (3) a boundary case using squad number 0 (just below the lowest seeded value of 1) to confirm the 404 path fires at the boundary. Additional sub-assertions pin the exact status code constant (404, not 400 or 422) to kill comparison-operator and constant mutations.

tests.name: test_put_existing_player_returns_204
preconditions: Database contains squad number 10 (Kabir Mary Reddy)
actions: Send PUT /players/squadnumber/10 with a valid body where squad_number=10
trace: R-PLAYER-012 — positive path: existing player must NOT yield 404
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_existing_player_returns_204():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Kabir",
        "middleName": "Mary",
        "lastName": "Reddy",
        "dateOfBirth": "1910-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 10,
        "position": "Right Winger",
        "abbrPosition": "DM",
        "team": "River Plate",
        "league": "Ligue 1",
        "starting11": False
    }
    r = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 204
    assert r.content == b""

tests.name: test_put_nonexistent_squad_number_returns_404
preconditions: Squad number 9999 does not exist in the database
actions: Send PUT /players/squadnumber/9999 with a valid body where squad_number=9999
trace: R-PLAYER-012 — primary error pathway: unknown playerId must yield HTTP 404
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_nonexistent_squad_number_returns_404():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Ghost",
        "middleName": None,
        "lastName": "Player",
        "dateOfBirth": "2000-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 9999,
        "position": "Goalkeeper",
        "abbrPosition": "GK",
        "team": "Unknown FC",
        "league": "Unknown League",
        "starting11": False
    }
    r = client.put("/players/squadnumber/9999", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 404
    assert r.status_code != 400
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 422

preconditions: Request body contains squad_number=2 while path uses squad_number=1
expected: Confirms the mismatch guard fires before the existence check
trace: R-PLAYER-012 — DT: body/path mismatch must yield 400, not 404; distinguishes the two error branches
